title: The Debt Strategy That Actually Works

beats.say: At 24% APR, debt doubles every 3 years due to the rule of 72.
beats.visual: A dark wooden desk with a single unlit desk lamp casting long shadows over a stack of unopened white envelopes.

beats.say: That $6,000 credit card balance can turn into 21 years of hell if you only pay the minimum.
beats.visual: A close-up shot of a human hand holding a heavy metal credit card by the edge, obscuring any numbers or text.

beats.say: You're bleeding cash on interest while feeling like you're getting nowhere fast.
beats.visual: A cinematic shot of a single drop of water falling into a dark pool, creating slow ripples under dim overhead light.

beats.say: Step one. Open your banking app right now and list every single balance you owe.
beats.visual: A blurred smartphone screen resting face down on a concrete countertop next to a metal pen.

beats.say: Step two. Pick your weapon. The debt avalanche targets your highest interest rate first.
beats.visual: A dimly lit room viewed from behind a person sitting at a wooden table looking out a window at dusk.

beats.say: The debt snowball targets your smallest balance first for quick psychological wins.
beats.visual: A stack of smooth river stones balanced precariously on top of each other on a dark slate surface.

beats.say: If you owe $3,000 at 24% APR, paying $300 a month wipes it out in just 12 months.
beats.visual: A close-up of hands typing rapidly on a mechanical keyboard with no letters visible on the dark gray keycaps.

beats.say: That same balance on minimum payments drags on for 15 years and costs $4,887 in interest.
beats.visual: An empty subway car moving fast through a dark tunnel, captured in motion blur from a low angle.

beats.say: But here's the part nobody mentions. Math says avalanche. Psychology says snowball.
beats.visual: A vintage brass balance scale resting on a wooden table, with one side slightly lower than the other.

beats.say: If you need early wins to stay motivated, pick the snowball method today.
beats.visual: A person's silhouette walking down a narrow concrete corridor away from the camera into soft morning light.

beats.say: If you want to pay the absolute least amount of total money, pick the avalanche.
beats.visual: A heavy steel vault door half-open in a dark concrete room with cold blue atmospheric lighting.
